id: 03_Safety Officer Interview Questions with Answers HSE Officer Interview Questions
title: 安全员面试问答：危害、风险与事故预防
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/03_Safety Officer Interview Questions with Answers HSE Officer Interview Questions.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/03_Safety Officer Interview Questions with Answers HSE Officer Interview Questions/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎收看安全员面试问答！
overlay: 安全知识问答：实验室安全管理入门

shots.scene: 白板上一级级台阶，从低到高
shots.prompt_en: A drawing of steps rising from low to high on a whiteboard, with a handshake icon at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 题目由易到难，一起来练。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着衬衫在面试室外翻空白笔记
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a neat shirt flips through a blank notebook outside an interview room.
shots.narration: 阿杰明天要面试安全员。

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰一叠空白问答卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a stack of blank question cards.
shots.narration: 小研说：先把基本概念背熟。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前举起马克笔
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a marker pen in front of the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 我们从最简单的题开始。

shots.scene: 人、财产、环境三个图标外罩一层盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A person icon, a building icon and a tree icon drawn on a whiteboard under one protective shield. No people.
shots.narration: 安全：免于伤人、损物、害环境的状态。

shots.scene: 欣欣在三个图标下面画线
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot underlines the three icons on the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 这三样都不受伤害，才叫安全。

shots.scene: 白板上画着警示三角和锐边、杂物图标
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard drawing of a warning triangle with a sharp edge icon and a cluttered floor icon. No people.
shots.narration: 危害：任何可能造成伤害的东西。

shots.scene: 割伤的手指和骨折的手臂图标
shots.prompt_en: Whiteboard icons of a cut finger with a bandage and an arm in a splint. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害：事故造成的身体损害。

shots.scene: 倒塌的货架、冒烟的机器、倒地的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Whiteboard icons of a toppled rack, a smoking machine and a fallen person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 事故：没有计划的意外事件。

shots.scene: 财产、环境、人身三个图标带红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A building icon, a tree icon and a person icon, each with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 会损坏财产、环境，甚至致人死亡。

shots.scene: 锤子从高处落下，落在小人图标旁边
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard drawing of a hammer falling and landing right next to an unharmed person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 未遂事件：锤子掉落，没砸到人。

shots.scene: 欣欣在“曾有可能”上画圈
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot circles a dashed arrow on the whiteboard and taps it with the marker.
shots.narration: 要点在于：它曾经有伤人的可能。

shots.scene: 骰子图标乘以伤害图标
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard equation: a dice icon, a multiplication sign and an injury icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风险：被危害伤到的可能性。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着算式
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the equation on the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 也可以写成可能性乘以后果。

shots.scene: 五个圆形图标：书、奖章、齿轮、法槌、放大镜
shots.prompt_en: Five round icons drawn on a whiteboard: a book, a medal, a gear, a gavel and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 预防事故的5E。

shots.scene: 王老师给工人们上培训课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of workers in hard hats in a training room.
shots.narration: 教育靠培训，激励靠奖励。

shots.scene: 老李给机器装防护罩，旁边规章文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a guard on a machine next to blank rule binders.
shots.narration: 工程措施控制，执行规章和HSE计划。

shots.scene: 放大镜扫过打勾清单
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass moves over a blank checklist with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一个E是评估。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔分五层
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid drawn on a whiteboard, divided into five colored layers. No people.
shots.narration: 控制层级：消除或减少危害的体系。

shots.scene: 危险桶图标被划掉，换成温和的桶
shots.prompt_en: A drum with a skull pictogram is crossed out and replaced by a drum with a milder pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 消除是彻底去掉，替代是降低危害。

shots.scene: 机器防护罩图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a machine with a guard fitted over moving parts. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制，就是工程防护措施。

shots.scene: 王老师把空白作业许可证交给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands a blank work permit to the young male student.
shots.narration: 管理控制：改变工作方式，作业许可。

shots.scene: 白板上画出安全帽、手套、护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Whiteboard icons of a hard hat, gloves and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 安全工作制度之后，最后是个人防护。

shots.scene: 杂乱和整洁的工作台对比
shots.prompt_en: A before-and-after whiteboard drawing: a messy workbench and the same bench neat and organized. No people.
shots.narration: 5S让工作场所整洁有序。

shots.scene: 阿杰把不用的工具设备搬走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries unused tools and equipment out to a storage bin.
shots.narration: 整理：清走不用的工具设备。

shots.scene: 小研把工具挂回轮廓板，擦干净台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs tools on a shadow board and wipes the bench.
shots.narration: 整顿有序摆放，清扫保持干净。

shots.scene: 墙上空白标准卡和日历上连续的勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard card on the wall and a calendar with a long row of check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 清洁建立标准，素养就是坚持。

shots.scene: 老周在空白承诺书上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank commitment document at his desk.
shots.narration: HSE方针：最高管理者的书面承诺。

shots.scene: 承诺书上方的心形和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank document icon with a heart and a shield above it. No people.
shots.narration: 承诺照顾员工工作中的健康安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白标准文本
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank standard booklet with a simple emblem on the cover.

shots.scene: 靶心图标中间一个大大的零
shots.prompt_en: A target icon with a large zero in the bullseye and an accident icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 一是总体声明：目标，比如零事故。

shots.scene: 人像图标和齿轮图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A person icon and then a gear icon light up on the whiteboard. No people.
shots.narration: 二是职责：谁负责；三是安排：怎么做。

shots.scene: 计划书从承诺书中延伸出来
shots.prompt_en: A blank plan booklet extends from a commitment document icon with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: HSE计划：实现方针承诺的计划。

shots.scene: 任务卡旁贴上危害标记和对策卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pins hazard markers and blank control cards next to task cards on a board.
shots.narration: 识别每项任务的风险，采取控制措施。

shots.scene: 一群工人图标外罩盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A group of worker pictograms under a protective shield. No people.
shots.narration: 目的是保障员工的安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着空白操作规程手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank procedure manual with numbered step icons.
shots.narration: SOP：详细的书面操作指令。

shots.scene: 手册上的步骤图标和危险作业图标
shots.prompt_en: A manual open to step icons next to a hazardous task icon with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 写明危险作业怎样安全完成。

shots.scene: 受限空间人孔和挖掘坑两个图标，各配一本手册
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, each with its own blank manual: a confined space manhole and an excavation pit. No people.
shots.narration: 受限空间、挖掘，各有各的SOP。

shots.scene: 五级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: Five stairs drawn on a whiteboard, each with an icon: a magnifying glass, people, a scale, a notepad and a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估五步。

shots.scene: 高处平台上的工具掉向地面行人
shots.prompt_en: A tool slips off a high work platform toward a person pictogram walking below. No people.
shots.narration: 比如高处作业，工具掉下伤到地面人。

shots.scene: 地面设隔离区，表格打勾
shots.prompt_en: A barricaded zone under the platform and a blank form getting check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 评估风险，采取措施，记录下来。

shots.scene: 新设备、新人员、新工作图标指向循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a new machine, a new worker and a new task all point to a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 工作、设备或人员变了，要回顾更新。

shots.scene: 放大镜对准事故示意图
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a simple accident diagram on a whiteboard. No people.
shots.narration: 事故调查有三个目的。

shots.scene: 树根、扳手、法规书三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: tree roots, a wrench and a law book. No people.
shots.narration: 找根本原因，定纠正措施，满足法律。

shots.scene: 日历上同一事故图标被划掉
shots.prompt_en: A calendar where a repeated accident icon is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 防止同样的事故再发生。

shots.scene: 会议桌两边人数相等
shots.prompt_en: A meeting table with equal numbers of seats on each side and a shield icon in the middle; the older man and the young male student sit across.
shots.narration: 安全委员会：员工代表和管理层开会。

shots.scene: 王老师主持，大家讨论空白议程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads a meeting while others discuss a blank agenda.
shots.narration: 会议专门讨论安全问题。

shots.scene: 天平两边小人一样多，保持平衡
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with the same number of person pictograms on each side, perfectly level. No people.
shots.narration: 按印度1948年工厂法第41G条，各占一半。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现危害、风险、事故、未遂图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a warning triangle, a dice, a collision and a falling hammer.
shots.narration: 六个基本定义要分清。

shots.scene: 5E圆圈、倒金字塔、5S图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a five-part circle, an inverted pyramid and a tidy bench. No people.
shots.narration: 5E、控制层级和5S。

shots.scene: 方针、计划、SOP、五级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a commitment document, a plan booklet, a procedure manual and five stairs. No people.
shots.narration: 方针、计划、SOP和风险评估。

shots.scene: 放大镜和会议桌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a magnifying glass and a meeting table. No people.
shots.narration: 事故调查和安全委员会。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在白板前击掌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student high-five in front of the whiteboard, then wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 背熟这些题，面试加油！
